programs.title: Get.Factual
programs.desc: Get.factual is a documentary streaming channel covering history, science, technology, and nature.

programs.title: Eagle Queen of the Skies
programs.desc: Eagles are top predators who battle fiercely for survival and work hard to raise their young. There are 60 members of the eagle clan, all united by their acute eyesight, powerful wings, sharp talons and hooked beaks. To explore the world of the eagle we follow one individual from hatching to leaving the nest and setting up a home. Her fight for survival reveals what it takes to become a queen of the sky.

programs.title: Anaconda Wanted
programs.desc: Anacondas have fired people's imagination since time immemorial. Hardly any other animal is so feared and yet at the same time so revered as the biggest snake in the world.

programs.title: Sudden Death
programs.desc: The gallery forests of the Serengeti are the realm of a phantom. The shadowy thickets are the domain of a Leopardess.

programs.title: Designed for Power
programs.desc: Adolf Hitler’s mastery of propaganda, and his instinctive skill for effective design, helps win huge popular support for the Nazi party, a vital step in its march towards total power.

programs.title: Hitler's Highways
programs.desc: Adolf Hitler promises to make Germany great again with his ambitious plans to create 22,000 kms of motorway and build one and half million “People’s Cars” every year.

programs.title: The Industry of War
programs.desc: Adolf Hitler is determined to rebuild Germany’s military strength after its humiliating defeat in the First World War by stealing raw materials from abroad.

programs.title: A Culture of Control
programs.desc: Adolf Hitler is determined to change the way German people think and feel by creating a new, Nazi form of art and culture. He takes control of all forms of media to spread Nazi propaganda.

programs.title: Himmler's Empire of Terror
programs.desc: Adolf Hitler’s bid for power depends on his most loyal and violent supporters, the SS. They use intimidation, detention, terror and even murder to defeat all the Nazis political enemies.

programs.title: Retreat from Reality
programs.desc: Hitler uses technology and terror to keep Germans fighting to the bitter end.

programs.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis
programs.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programs.title: Rising Sun
programs.desc: After briefly setting the scene, Episode One delves into the early years of Emperor Hirohito’s reign.

programs.title: For the Sake of the Country
programs.desc: Episode Two explores the military’s tightening control over Japanese society, the disbanding of labour unions and influences upon education.

programs.title: The Sun that Shines
programs.desc: Japan seized more than 2,500,000 km² of land in Southeast Asia and almost the entire western half of the Pacific.

programs.title: An Extraordinary Measure
programs.desc: On the day that Nagasaki was bombed, the Trans Baikal and 2nd Far East Fronts of the Red Army invaded Manchuria, the 1st Far East Front moved from Vladivostok.

programs.title: Countdown to Surrender: The End
programs.desc: The final act of the Second World War is its most costly episode. More than one million German soldiers die in 1945 alone.
